examples.upstream_description: Offline breadcrumb/return-navigation on M5Stack PaperMono (Meshtastic RX + e-ink). Ecosystem peer of cardputer
examples.notes: Radio config differs from the vendor demo in every parameter: 923.000 MHz / BW 125 kHz / SF9 / CR 4-5 / sync 0x3A vs factory 868.0 / 62.5 / SF12 / 4-8 / 0x34 — an independent cross-check that the documented bring-up is not vendor folklore. Its led.rs comment independently confirms the RGB LED is three discrete lines and explicitly not WS2812. No licence file.
